assets.title: A Rideau Canal lock in winter - a level 4 point-of-interest hero
assets.author: TrueNorth contributors
assets.modifications: Original work. Drawn from assets/refs/ottawa/rideau-canal-ottawa-locks.jpg under the rules in assets/style/art-bible.md; never traced. That photograph is a summer exposure with water spilling over the gates; the level is winter, so the chamber is drawn with ice and the copings with snow and nothing is falling. The @1x suffix pins the source to one scale; the key ottawa-prop-rideau-locks carries no suffix. The art-bible section 5 two-size test was run at the shipping size of 680 x 440 and passed at both probes; at 2x it would cost 4.57 MiB of decoded texture instead of 1.14 MiB.

assets.title: The Library of Parliament - a level 4 point-of-interest hero
assets.author: TrueNorth contributors
assets.modifications: Original work. Drawn from assets/refs/ottawa/parliament-hill-north-library.jpg under the rules in assets/style/art-bible.md; never traced. That photograph is a dark overcast exposure and is a geometry reference only; the sandstone and the roof are palette.json's stone and slate ramps. No cross, no statue, no clock and no flag: the reference carries a crocketed finial and a pinnacle cross on the building behind it, and neither is drawn. The @1x suffix pins the source to one scale; the key ottawa-prop-library-of-parliament carries no suffix. The art-bible section 5 two-size test was run at the shipping size of 600 x 820 and passed at both probes; at 2x it would cost 7.51 MiB of decoded texture instead of 1.88 MiB.

assets.title: A warming hut on the Rideau Canal Skateway - a level 4 point-of-interest hero

assets.title: A saddled bay ranch horse under a western saddle, which the player rides across the Alberta foothills
assets.author: TrueNorth contributors
assets.modifications: Original work, drawn under assets/style/art-bible.md and never traced, from three references: assets/refs/alberta-foothills/quarter-horse-side-elevation.jpg, a photograph by Derrick Coetzee released under CC0; cow-horse-under-western-saddle.jpg, a photograph by Linda (Flickr user 9878580@N03), licensed CC BY 2.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/); and horse-walking-muybridge-plate-574.jpg, Eadweard Muybridge's plate 574, in the public domain. Carries no brand, number, name or lettering of any kind, and a plain felt pad with no pattern. The behind layer of a ride (ADR-0031): the player is drawn in front of it, astride. Since ADR-0035 it is frame 1 of the ride's four-frame walk and the one frame drawn under reduced motion; the saddle, pad, cinch and stirrup are the group "seat", drawn identically in every frame. The @1x suffix pins the source to one scale; the key alberta-foothills-ride-ranch-horse carries no suffix.
